name: Jedaiah
overview: The name Jedaiah appears in Scripture primarily associated with the priestly lineage following the return from Babylonian exile. Jedaiah is identified as a descendant of Simeon and is noted among the priests who returned from captivity, serving in Jerusalem during the post-exilic restoration period. The records in Ezra and Nehemiah highlight the prominence of Jedaiah's family within the priestly divisions, emphasizing their role in the religious life of the restored community. These passages underscore the faithfulness of God's people in reestablishing worship and priestly service centered on the temple in Jerusalem.
